meta.description: Authoritative registry for implementation-equivalence failures and drift boundaries.

failure_classes.description: Numerical difference between implementations exceeding relative/absolute tolerances.
A specific simulation run (seed/config) that failed equivalence checks.
Divergence in emergent regime classification or phase transition boundaries.
Numerical sensitivity where small changes in seeds produce non-equivalent outputs across backends.
Failure of an implementation to produce bit-identical results across identical runs (if required).
Performance optimizations (e.g., SIMD, GPU precision) that changed the semantic behavior of the process.
